caption: The drawing features a large, central, flower-like shape with rounded, symmetrical petals outlined in a light brown color. Around this central shape are two concentric, irregular borders: the inner one is blue, and the outer one is pink, each mimicking the outline of the central motif. A smaller, simplified flower motif, outlined in brown, is placed at the center of the main shape, with a single blue dot at its core. Surrounding the central motif are four symmetric, leaf-like shapes located at the cardinal points, each outlined in dark brown with inner light brown sections and accents of blue lines. Smaller tan-colored leaves extend outward in the spaces between these larger motifs. The background is a light beige color with no additional pattern or shading. The overall composition is symmetrical and uses a palette consisting primarily of beige, brown, blue, pink, and tan. Handwritten text in green is visible in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Colcha
